structure: Part 3 mined all 6 traces from about-the-consignment.fit.spec.js in its 'what are you importing' (5) and 'germinal products: section 1' (1) describes: renders the commodity search for live animals (WAI-render, spec line 168), nothing selected is an error (WAI-error, 188), search lists the species of a commodity; ticking one adds it to the selection (WAI-search, 196), several commodities can be selected together, and cleared (WAI-several, 215), save and return to overview keeps the selection without validating (WAI-hub, 228), and category start, germinal search hint and the reduced list of reasons (GERM, 324). Trace refs below use the zip name's distinguishing tail. Every live-animals trace starts the same way: /design-release-2.1/create-notification redirects to notification-type, live-animals is checked, then origin-of-the-import is filled (France, no region code) and continued, landing on /design-release-2.1/what-are-you-importing. Pages, in journey order: (1) germinal category start: /design-release-2.1/create-notification?category=germinal-products redirects straight to origin-of-the-import, whose back link is /design-release-2.1/germinal-products (GERM only); (2) What are you importing? (all 6 traces): status bar (Draft tag and GBN-AG reference), caption 'About the consignment', h1, an ITAHC inset, a custom commodity search (label, hint, search input, search button, live results list of commodity headers with species checkboxes, a polite status region, a 'N selected' panel with per-commodity chips, Remove buttons and Clear all, four hidden inputs carrying the selection), a 'Help with commodity codes' details, Save and continue, Save and return to overview, Cancel and return to overview, back link to origin-of-the-import; its error state (WAI-error); the germinal variant of its hint and results (GERM); (3) Overview /design-release-2.1/notification-hub, reached by Save and return to overview with nothing selected (WAI-hub); (4) Main import reason, reached from a germinal selection (GERM), showing only Internal market (with its four purposes) and Transit. No commodity data request goes over the wire: commodity search runs in the page. Conditional: the germinal hint and results appear only on the germinal-products route; the selected panel and Clear all appear only once something is ticked; the error state only after Save and continue with no selection. Not walked anywhere in this part: removing a single chip, a search with no matches, ova or embryos searches, selecting a whole commodity rather than a species, and saving a real selection through Save and return to overview; each is a gap claim.

claims.statement: On the germinal reason page, choosing Internal market reveals 'Purpose in the internal market' with four options and hints: Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift, Breeding, Research and Production.
claims.quote:
Purpose in the internal market
Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift
Any movement of an animal that has as its aim the sale of or the transfer of ownership of the animal from one person or entity to another. For example, animals that have been sold and are being moved to a new owner or will be sold once in Great Britain, purchases from a breeder/shop overseas and where an animal is being moved to a new owner with no sale involved (for example a gift).
Breeding
Animals for reproduction. This includes animals intended to contribute to the genetic pool of a breeding program, improve livestock quality, or produce offspring.
Research
Animals for use in scientific or medical research.
Production
Animals that are farmed for the production of meat, milk, eggs, wool or any other animal product or by-product.

claims.statement: The commodity search is a custom component outside govuk-frontend (app-commodity-search: input, icon button, results list, selected panel with chips, live status); only the species rows reuse GOV.UK checkboxes. The nearest standard parts are a GOV.UK text input with a search button and Checkboxes; there is no govuk-frontend autocomplete with multi-select chips.

The page's caption and heading use custom classes (app-what-importing-page__caption, app-what-importing-page__heading) rather than govuk-caption-l and govuk-heading-l, and the field label uses app-eu-heading-m rather than a govuk-label modifier.
The page otherwise uses standard GOV.UK components: Inset text, Details, Button (primary and secondary), Error summary, Error message, Back link and Tag.
